title: Could You Have Seen Accenture Stock's Rebound Coming?
summary: Accenture (ACN) stock rose roughly 43% between June 18 and September 18, 2026, while the S&P 500 gained 2.3%. The run began near its 52-week low, on the day the company reported fiscal Q3 2026 and announced a much larger push into security software and smaller clients. That push had been building in plain sight across three earlier earnings calls. Whether spotting it would have made you money is a harder question.
